# telnyx_mobile_phone_numbers_messaging_settings (Data Source)

Mobile phone numbers on the account with their messaging settings.

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `mobile_phone_numbers_messaging_settings` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mobile_phone_numbers_messaging_settings))

### Nested Schema for `mobile_phone_numbers_messaging_settings.features`

Read-Only:

- `sms` (Attributes) The set of features available for a specific messaging use case (SMS or MMS). Features can vary depending on the characteristics the phone number, as well as its current product configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mobile_phone_numbers_messaging_settings--features--sms))

<a id="nestedatt--mobile_phone_numbers_messaging_settings--features--sms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mobile_phone_numbers_messaging_settings.features.sms`

Read-Only:

- `domestic_two_way` (Boolean) Send messages to and receive messages from numbers in the same country.
- `international_inbound` (Boolean) Receive messages from numbers in other countries.
- `international_outbound` (Boolean) Send messages to numbers in other countries.
